artifacts.description: Quartus Prime Pro EDA netlist export (version not recorded in the header)

assumptions.description: The analysed file is the anonymised import: module, port, net and instance names are meaningless and internal vector declarations have been split into unrelated scalars, so no claim here can rest on a name or on a word boundary the vendor tool happened to keep.

The family is decided by the rule table in spec.md section 4, fixed before these exports were analysed and calibrated on walkthroughs 11-15. A rule that fires is a structural observation, never an identification of an algorithm.

all_reasons.reason: no carry chain anywhere and 40 pairwise-disjoint cells, each a pure XOR of exactly 5 flip-flop outputs

call.reason: no carry chain anywhere and 40 pairwise-disjoint cells, each a pure XOR of exactly 5 flip-flop outputs

evidence: S-box extraction: 0 bijective non-affine substitution(s) of 3..8 bits found in the LUT cones
shift registers: 0 chain(s) of at least 4 stages, 0 of them closed by a feedback function
ARX: no carry-chain adder of at least 4 bits; no fixed rotation, in a named vector or in the order a cell layer reads a register bank
modular arithmetic: no add/subtract pair over the same operand registers; no carry chain with a constant operand, so no modulus to read
permutation layers: 0 non-identity bit map(s) between equally wide vectors

method.description: The six steps of examples/agilex3_walkthroughs/16_mystery_cores/spec.md section 3 over an anonymized Quartus export, followed by the fixed rule table of section 4. No behavioural simulation and no reference model: a reference model is a hypothesis about what the design is, and there is nothing to compare one against until the reveal.
method.name: blind structural identification

findings.summary: Blind call: family sponge, style undetermined, confidence medium. Deciding rule R2-sponge -- no carry chain anywhere and 40 pairwise-disjoint cells, each a pure XOR of exactly 5 flip-flop outputs. hal_crypto identify said none-detected (medium).
findings.title: Blind identification of core_a: sponge

notes: Produced without reading anything under ground_truth/. The letter in the artifact id is the only thing this document knows about the design it describes.
